dialogues.speaker: Flight Trial Grounds Notice
dialogues.text: "This is the flight trial grounds. All personnel must obey regulations to avoid unnecessary accidents."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "8. In non-emergency situations, please follow the ground guides, keep to fixed flight paths, and take off and landings at safe speeds. Dangerous actions are strictly prohibited."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "Note: 'The Saurian did it' shall not be considered an acceptable excuse. Qucusaurs have an innate capacity for safe flight, but humans do not."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Trial Notice
dialogues.text: "All candidates wishing to take part in the flight test must first clear mental aptitude and physical examinations before being allowed to practice take-offs."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Trial Notice
dialogues.text: "Meanwhile, all flight-related training must be conducted under the protection and supervision of a tutor. Any unauthorized training will result in permanent loss of eligibility for flight trials."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Trial Notice
dialogues.text: "Administrators reserve the right to terminate any training currently underway, and if a termination signal is received, please follow all instructions in returning to the arena."

dialogues.speaker: Emergency Notice
dialogues.text: "Listen carefully, everyone: I have discussed this with the chief, and everyone needs to be examined again. Only those who make the cut in both mental and physical aptitude will be issued their wings once more!"

dialogues.speaker: Emergency Notice
dialogues.text: "Otherwise, you will be required to stay in the vicinity of the arena to receive treatment. All candidates must undergo re-examination, especially anyone who has come into contact with Abyssal forces!"

dialogues.speaker: Emergency Notice
dialogues.text: "Of course, if you don't wish to undergo testing again, all you have to do is beat Miss Chasca in combat, and we'll consider you fighting fit!"

dialogues.speaker: Emergency Notice
dialogues.text: "Can't quite manage that? Haha, then quit yapping and get your treatment sorted! Once treated, you'll be allowed to fly again."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "34: Those who release junk while airborne will be subject to lifetime imprisonment."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "For the safety of everyone, nobody is allowed to release any airborne objects around the trial grounds without obtaining prior approval. This includes kites, balloons, and birds!"

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "In a previous case, someone released a balloon and it impacted a Qucusaurus' flight path. If it weren't for a flying squad member administering timely assistance, the results would have been disastrous!"

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "The chief has also stated that safety is paramount. This kind of thing cannot happen again. So follow the rules, everyone!"

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "52: Do not shout or scream while flying, and do not make strange noises."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "The former will disorient other people (or Saurians), while the latter may be misinterpreted as an instruction by Qucusaurs, thus creating unnecessary safety hazards."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "Note: 'I'm singing' shall not be considered a valid excuse for making strange noises. The definition of what constitutes a 'song' here shall be left to the majority consensus of people (or Saurians)."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "37: For safety reasons, please do not carry any creatures with you incapable of flight."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "Note: In theory, humans are also a species without plumage who walk on two legs, and who are incapable of flight."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "Further Note: 'My friend has a wind glider — that totally counts as having flight capabilities' shall not be considered a valid excuse."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "26: Please do not carry any valuables with you when flying to avoid dropping them."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "If a similar situation occurs, please ask any flying squad for assistance."

dialogues.speaker: Chief's Message
dialogues.text: "Due to the variance in difficulty involved in finding different items, our flying squads cannot guarantee definite retrieval of any lost belongings. Please pay close attention and follow all regulations."
